# MASKED

> MASKED is a free, open-source (MIT), self-custodial Bitcoin wallet for Chrome and Android. One recovery phrase gives two balances: Public (a normal taproot address, bc1p…) and Shielded (a silent-payments address, sp1…, BIP 352) that nobody can look up. It also holds BRC-20, Ordinals, LEAF (CRC-20), RGB tokens and Cashu ecash, and gives websites a UniSat-compatible provider, window.masked. Experimental, unaudited: small amounts only. Ecash and the Launchpad escrow are custodial; everything else is self-custodial. Built by @ratsonchain on X.

## Use it

- [Getting started](https://github.com/buildOrDie/masked-wallet/blob/main/docs/GETTING-STARTED.md): install, create or restore, receive, send, shield
- [FAQ](https://github.com/buildOrDie/masked-wallet/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md): safety, Shielded vs Public, Signet, RGB backups, ecash
- [News and videos](https://github.com/buildOrDie/masked-wallet/blob/main/docs/NEWS.md): what's new in each update
- [Safety and known limits](https://github.com/buildOrDie/masked-wallet/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/masked-wallet/pojmpfcbdmacabhckemelcbkmckhaoig)
- [Android APK](https://signet.maskedwallet.com/install)
- [Website](https://maskedwallet.com)
